digest.component_or_area: bulk event import path (import_ndjson, event_append, staging)
propositions: The import_tickets path makes 6,000 subprocess-backed git config user.name lookups (one per append_event call) consuming 47.79s of the 77-90s total import runtime, despite reading the same author value for the entire bulk operation.

The batch_stage_and_commit path calls sweep_stale_staging 3,000 times (once per CREATE) with 375,876 owner checks, consuming 15.94s, rescanning the same staging root while earlier prepared items remain unpublished within a single batch.

Replacing only the git-config and sweep collaborators with side-effect-free logical equivalents reduced identical-state N=3000 import from 77.231s to 16.404s (60.827s delta, 78.8% reduction) while preserving all 3,000 creates, 3,000 comments, and 24 commits.

The optimization must scope author caching only to explicit import contexts, preserve per-call lookups for interactive/direct writes, and amortize stale sweeps to at most once per batch without changing event bytes, crash-safety semantics, or commit-count guarantees.
Interactive and direct stage_event callers must retain live author lookup and stale-sweep defaults; empty batches and existing-ticket-only batches must not introduce new sweep overhead.
